description: Phase 6 Wave 1 — Plan 01: Extract Value Designer and SPI system prompts to src/context/agents/, add getValueDesignerContext() and getSPIContext() loaders to src/lib/context.ts. Base branch: ralph/phase-5-multi-agent-shell.

userStories.title: Extract Value Designer system prompt (merge base spec + JTBD update) to src/context/agents/
userStories.description: As the system, I need the merged Value Designer system prompt available as a plain-text file so the route handler can inject it on every request.
acceptanceCriteria: Create directory `src/context/agents/` if it doesn't exist
Read `Value Designer/FUND_II_Value_Designer_Agent_Spec.txt` and `Value Designer/FUND_II_Value_Designer_JTBD_Integration_Update.txt`

Merge the JTBD Integration Update modifications into the base spec — the update adds JTBD language ('Life Areas', 'struggling moments', 'four forces of progress', 'WHEN [situation]') to the relevant activities in the base spec. Read both files carefully to understand which sections are modified
Write the merged result to `src/context/agents/value-designer.txt`
Verify the file contains: `Life Areas` (from JTBD update)
Verify the file contains: `struggling moments` (from JTBD update)
Verify the file contains: `four forces` (from JTBD update)
Verify the file is non-empty (at least 10000 characters)
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` — passes
userStories.notes: Read both VD spec files fully before merging. The JTBD Integration Update modifies specific activities in the 6-activity workflow — apply those modifications to the corresponding sections in the base spec. The merged file should read as a single coherent system prompt, not two concatenated documents. Do NOT create a TypeScript file — just write the merged plain text to src/context/agents/value-designer.txt.

userStories.title: Copy SPI system prompt to src/context/agents/spi.txt
userStories.description: As the system, I need the SPI system prompt available as a plain-text file so the SPI route handler can inject it.
acceptanceCriteria: Read `SPI - Sythetic Persona Interviewer/SPI_Agent_Spec_v1_1.txt`
Write the content to `src/context/agents/spi.txt`
Verify the file contains `END INTERVIEW` (SPI debrief trigger phrase)
Verify the file contains `Synthetic Persona` or `synthetic persona` (core concept)
Verify the file is non-empty (at least 5000 characters)
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` — passes
userStories.notes: This is a direct copy — read the .txt file and write it to the new location. Do not modify the content.

userStories.title: Add getValueDesignerContext() and getSPIContext() loaders to src/lib/context.ts
userStories.description: As the system, I need exported loader functions for the VD and SPI context files so route handlers can import and call them just like getSystemContext().
acceptanceCriteria: Read `src/lib/context.ts` to understand the existing getSystemContext() pattern
Add `export function getValueDesignerContext(): string` that reads `src/context/agents/value-designer.txt` using the same fs.readFileSync pattern as existing loaders
Add `export function getSPIContext(): string` that reads `src/context/agents/spi.txt` using the same fs.readFileSync pattern
Both functions use `path.join(process.cwd(), 'src/context/agents/...')` for the file path
src/lib/context.ts contains `export function getValueDesignerContext`
src/lib/context.ts contains `export function getSPIContext`
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes
userStories.notes: Read src/lib/context.ts first to match the exact pattern used by getSystemContext(). Use the same approach — readFileSync at startup or lazily. Follow whatever caching pattern already exists in the file.
